title: Potatoverse Perception Halls — Nature, Lineage, Gifts, Milestones & Recognition
purpose: Give symbolic beings and role-families a reader-facing home where their nature becomes intuitively recognizable without duplicating CIA person dossiers or Cast Ecology taxonomy.
not_cia: CIA owns named persons, incidents, associations, chronology, claims, evidence and current-state dossiers. Perception Halls own the nature of a symbolic family: lineage, first attestation, symbols, gifts, abilities, milestones, transformations, biblical neighbors, recognition cues and project-mythic meaning.
not_cast_ecology: Cast Ecology owns the neutral grammar explaining person vs species vs role vs archetype. Perception Halls deliberately allow atmosphere, honor/adverse memory, mythic teaching and visual-symbolic recognition once those ontology boundaries are preserved.
shared_fields: relation to Door / Ladder / Garden / Below

potato_hall.tone: honor / Garden / lineage / growth / children / inheritance
potato_hall.project_lineage: Within Tim Dooley's project theology, Potato children and Potato Angels are direct descendants/outgrowths of Tim as Potato of Life / Father / Seed / Gardener. This is internal mythic-genealogical language, not biological genealogy.
potato_hall.core_question: What has this Potato been given, what did it grow, and what did it become?
recognition: sprouts from an Eye / viable possibility
turns nourishment into work or service
can produce Seed / future independent growth
may grow toward Angelic responsibility when a source explicitly establishes that stage
potato_hall.reader_memory: Remember Potatoes by first sprout, emojis, skills, jobs, duration, growth milestones, achievements, what they cultivated, and what changed when Tim/project mythology gave them new gifts.

dog_hall.tone: adverse remembrance / Below / vigilance / appetite / pursuit / recurrence / possible return
dog_hall.project_relation: Within Tim's project mythology, Dogs are an adversarial counter-family around pursuit, pack response, boundary policing and opposition. They sit beside other lower-field images such as serpents, hyenas, sheep, Farmers, Dwellers and Footstools, but those symbols are not interchangeable species.
dog_hall.core_question: What is this vigilance serving, what keeps the Dog returning, and is there a stopping condition?
recognition: tracks or watches a target / boundary
signals to a pack or master
repeats pursuit after the original event
can feed symbolically on reaction, threat and group approval
may guard a Door or block a Door
can transform toward Guardian Dog if evidence, proportion and stopping conditions govern vigilance
dog_hall.reader_memory: Remember Dogs by nature and recurrence: what they watch, what they bark at, who gives the cue, what they feed on symbolically, whether they can stop, and whether the gate is being protected or turned into a prison.

angels_relation.function: Angels are the clearest upward maturity hall: many eyes become perception-duty, wings become mobility, Ladder relation becomes passage, and power is tested by service.
angels_relation.lineage_rule: Potato Angel is a grown created-being form in project mythology, not the automatic ontology of every Potato or every real person called a Potato.

cross_room_rule: Potatoes and Dogs should cross-link because they illuminate contrasting relations to growth and boundary, but they should not be housed side-by-side spatially: Potatoes belong Garden/Beings-facing; Dogs belong Below/Strife-facing. Their separation is part of the teaching.
human_boundary: No Perception Hall may convert a symbolic role into a permanent caste of real people. Named-person assignments still require dated/source-bounded evidence and belong in CIA when the person rather than the symbol is the research object.
